description: T3 curation in rounds (user decision 2026-10-02). Round 1 = practitioner guides, fault reviews and rule-targeted papers covering all 12 rules; later rounds are added before ingest/E5, never chosen from eval results. A urls.txt entry curates every kept URL in that list. Run: python data_pipeline/curator.py --out curated_data_v6 --excluded excluded_from_kb_v6 --skip-list data_pipeline/prefilter_v6.json --usage-log data_pipeline/curation_usage_v6.jsonl --batch data_pipeline/curation_batches_v6.json <name>

trial.note: Done 2026-10-02 with --only before batches existed (53 windows).

round1.note: ~253 windows. Every rule gets 2+ direct sources; thin rules (knee_varus, straight_back_leg, excessive_front_knee_flexion, partial_pushup) get the rule-named papers.
